games.summary: Cashkidz builds the Neos board and takes game 1.

beats.text: Cashkidz opens The Eternal Kingdom and uses Hulking Rearguard to contest the early Paladin.
Enfeebling Orb holds back ClourX’s influence while Cashkidz levels into Tonoris.
Reciprocity makes swords, and Atmos Armor Type-Ares establishes shields.
Hulking Rearguard, Ares and the swords finish the game.

games.summary: ClourX levels the match with Burst Asunder.

beats.text: Cashkidz answers the burn exchange with two Storm of Thorns; the first is negated, but the second resolves.
ClourX negates Atmos Armor Type-Ares, then finishes with Burst Asunder.

games.summary: Cashkidz survives the Fractal pressure and wins with Neos weapons and allies.

beats.text: Frostsworn Paladin applies early pressure while Cashkidz searches for Eternal Kingdom.
Topsy Decree protects Cashkidz during the Refracting Missile exchange.
Cashkidz reaches level 3 and establishes Atmos Armor Type-Ares with shields.
A second Ares and the final Reciprocity attack close the match.

match.sourceNote: All three games reviewed from the original transcript and bounded audio retranscriptions. Omnidex confirms Cashkidz 2–1. Names normalized against the card catalog; play descriptions remain commentary-sourced.

games.summary: Rty concedes with Neek0 threatening a Polar Depths mill finish.

beats.text: Neek0 establishes the Fractal mill engine; Rty uses Purifying Thurible to clear the early graveyard, then advances Tristan with Beseech the Winds.
Rty advances through Shadowreaver into Shadowdancer and establishes Shadows.
Enfeebling Orb and Cerulean Decree stop Mastermind Scheme.
Neek0 builds the graveyard while Rty cannot find enough damage; Rty concedes before the threatened Polar Depths turn.

games.summary: Neek0 rebuilds the Genbu defense as time expires; the game result remains unresolved.

beats.text: Rty develops Tristan after an early missed preparation trigger.
Neek0 responds to Nullifying Lantern with Polar Depths, then uses Song of Frost to disrupt Sadi attacks.
Cerulean Decree protects Regal Inquisition from Incapacitate, removing key cards from Rty’s hand.
Ensnaring Fumes clears the board after Genbu transforms.
Neek0 pays nine to materialize Fabled Sapphire Fatestone again and rebuilds to nine quest counters as the match reaches time.
